about.heading: About
paragraphs: Software developer focused on building web applications and enterprise systems.

I began my studies in Information Technology in 2022, when I enrolled at the São Paulo College of Technology. Since then, I have been continuously learning and improving my knowledge of how to build systems more effectively.
My goal is to solve problems and help companies and people achieve their goals through technology.
